summary: Iteration 5 testing verifies (A) profile-birthday auto-event lifecycle (create/update/clear/user-delete), (B) reminder 7-day catch-up window via /api/cron/reminders, (C) Google Calendar OAuth endpoints (status/login/sync/disconnect) and sanitize_user strips google_tokens, plus frontend Calendar 'Google verbinden' redirect and EventModal (multi reminders, birthday toggle) and Dashboard 'Nächste 3 Wochen' shows auto birthday. Backend: 46/46 pytest passed (added TestBirthdayAutoEvent [2], TestReminderCatchUp [1], TestGoogleEndpoints [6] on top of the iteration-4 baseline of 37). Frontend Playwright: login by USERNAME (Mama/mama) works, /kalender shows 'Google verbinden' (data-testid google-connect-button visible), clicking it navigates to https://accounts.google.com/... with the correct client_id 503943354251-...apps.googleusercontent.com, scope calendar+userinfo.email+openid, and redirect_uri /api/google/callback. Setting Mama profile birthday=1990-09-27 via PUT /api/profile rendered a birthday pill on the current day cell in the month grid, and dashboard-upcoming rendered exactly 'Geburtstag Mama / So., 27.09. · Mama'. EventModal open via new-event-button showed add-reminder-button (2 clicks -> reminder-row-0 and reminder-row-1), event-birthday-toggle togglable, save-event-button visible. Cleanup: Mama birthday reset to '' and auto event removed. Non-interactive Google flow: /google/status returns {connected:false} initially, /google/login returns authorization_url containing accounts.google.com and GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, /google/sync returns 400 when not connected, /google/disconnect returns 200, /google/login without auth returns 401, /auth/me does NOT expose google_tokens. Reminder catch-up: event today 00:01 with 1-minute reminder -> POST /api/cron/reminders with correct Bearer marks reminders_sent=['0'] (delivered late within 7d window); missing/invalid Bearer returns 401.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1339 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Splitting into modules (auth, users, events, google, reminders, whiteboard, notebooks, markers, ical) is overdue and would isolate the growing Google integration surface.

_google_flow() hardcodes GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI from env — good — but google_callback swallows all exceptions and just redirects to /kalender?google=error without logging the underlying error; add logger.exception in the except branch for future debuggability.

google_callback exchanges the code manually via requests.post (not using flow.fetch_token) and stores the raw token response including refresh_token in db.users.google_tokens. sanitize_user correctly strips this on read, but no encryption-at-rest for refresh tokens; consider Fernet-encrypting google_tokens.refresh_token.

POST /api/google/sync pulls up to timeMax=+365d and pushes ALL local events created_by=user without a source filter EXCEPT profile_birthday — good — but there is no pagination and no rate-limit handling; a family with many events could hit Google API quotas. Consider batching and try/except around each push.

_process_reminders re-scans ALL events with reminders on every tick (server startup + POST /cron/reminders). At scale this is O(N). Consider indexing {reminders_sent: ...} + storing a next_due_at field to narrow the query.

_sync_birthday_event stores yearly_repeat=True + category='birthday' but does NOT set 'reminders' when updating an existing event via $set doc (doc only contains title/date/time/category/yearly_repeat/created_by). Safe (won't overwrite reminders since key absent from doc), but be aware that changing user name will $set title and lose no data. Verified.
EventBody still accepts arbitrary reminders payload (List[Dict]); consider a Pydantic sub-model {value:int>=0, unit:Literal['minutes','hours','days']} for validation.

google_sync uses creds.token vs. stored access_token to detect refresh — good. But if refresh fails Credentials.refresh raises and is uncaught in the endpoint; wrap with a try/except returning 401 to prompt reconnect UI-side.
test_credentials: Admin/admin (admin), Mama/mama (user); WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET from backend/.env used for /api/cron/reminders; GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID present in .env — no real Google consent completed (as instructed).
